test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following items is NOT recorded in profit and loss account ?
solution:
The correct answer is** Return outward is not recorded in the profit and loss account.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Return outward:**

 
 
• Return outward, also known as purchase returns, refers to goods that a business returns to its suppliers. This transaction is recorded in the purchase returns account and is deducted from total purchases in the trading account, not in the profit and loss account.
 
• It impacts the cost of goods sold (COGS) calculation but does not directly affect the profit and loss account.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Administrative expenses:**

 
 
• These are overhead costs related to the general operation of a business, such as salaries of office staff, rent, utilities, and office supplies. They are recorded in the profit and loss account as they directly affect the net profit of the business.
 
 
 
• **Depreciation of office assets:**
 
 
• Depreciation represents the reduction in value of office assets over time due to wear and tear, age, or obsolescence. It is recorded as an expense in the profit and loss account to reflect the cost of using long-term assets.
 
 
 
• **Profit on sale of assets:**
 
 
• When a business sells an asset and makes a profit, this profit is recorded in the profit and loss account. It is part of other incomes or gains and contributes to the overall profitability of the business.
